label: Ted Cruz wins Texas Senate 2024 by a landslide
description: Vision of Ted Cruz winning Texas Senate 2024 with '23,000 extra votes' and a landslide. Made Nov 1 2024, before Nov 5 election.

label: Democrats attempt to impeach Trump in 2026
description: Repeated vision of 'impeach impeach impeach by Schumer and the Democratic Party' escalating through summer 2026. First stated Jan 2026.

label: Greenland holds a vote to join the United States
description: Vision of Greenland divided: young people vote to join US, elders oppose. Stated Jan 9 2026.

label: Gavin Newsom corruption and embarrassing moments exposed
description: Vision of 'dark things uncovered' about Gavin Newsom, corruption in California, embarrassing moments for politicians. First stated Jun 8 2025.

label: Nancy Pelosi retires from Congress
description: Stated Mar 14 2025: 'Nancy Pelosi is going to retire.' Also Oct 2024 prayer for her removal. Pelosi announced retirement late 2025.

label: Chuck Schumer retires from the Senate
description: Stated Mar 14 2025: 'Chuck Schumer is going to retire.' Schumer has not announced retirement as of Oct 2026.

label: JD Vance scandal called new Watergate in 2028
description: Repeated vision: 'Watergate 2028' scandal involving JD Vance and Elon Musk, impeachment attempt. Stated multiple times from Jan 2026.

label: Texas Senate seat competitive or flips Democrat 2026
description: Vision of a Democrat winning or competing closely in Texas Senate. Multiple passages reference Texas Senate race 2026.
